# cortex_entity_relationship (Resource)

Manages the full set of destination entities for a given source entity and relationship type. Creating or updating this resource replaces all destinations for the specified source + relationship type combination. Deleting this resource clears all destinations (sets them to empty).

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "cortex_entity_relationship" "example" {
  source_entity_tag     = "products-service"
  relationship_type_tag = "service-to-database"
  destination_entity_tags = [
    "products-db",
    "variants-db",
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `destination_entity_tags` (Set of String) Set of entity tags that are destinations for this relationship from the source entity. An empty set is valid and clears all destinations.
- `relationship_type_tag` (String) Tag of the relationship type.
- `source_entity_tag` (String) Tag of the source catalog entity.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Composite identifier in the format `source_entity_tag:relationship_type_tag`.
